title: Quebec City under Siege – Military Walking Tour
includes: Walking tour in Old Quebec with a licensed guide.
Gratuity for the guide is at your discretion (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The destiny of New France was played out on the Plains of Abraham on September 13, 1759. But the many sieges and battles that took place before and even after this turning point in history shaped Quebec's military heritage. This heritage remains clearly visible today and is an integral part of the architecture and of Quebec’s local culture. Led by an authentic military figure, explore the fortified city starting from the Governor’s garden, Wolfe & Montcalm monument on a circuit that will take you by the Fortifications, by historic gates and other military heritage sites.
